title: data for billing.overage_limit_reached
description: The authorized overage reached the integrator's BRL limit for the cycle: new sends above the allowance are refused with 402 ALLOWANCE_EXHAUSTED (reason overage_limit_reached). Sent at most once per cycle. Envelope business_id and channel_id are null.

overage_limit_micros.description: Overage limit authorized for the cycle. Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").

overage_used_micros.description: Overage already counted in the cycle (sends awaiting delivery included). Integer string in micros (R$ 1 = "1000000").
